about.description: Zeke's Landing and Marina sits just across the street from some of the most beautiful beaches in the country. A mere 10-minute boat ride from the Gulf of Mexico. Zeke's boasts a long history of excellence in the charter fishing industry and proudly hosts the largest charter fleet on the Gulf. The facility offers a variety of dry dock options, premier customer service, and an environmentally friendly approach to operating a marina.
about.elevator_pitch: Orange Beach's premier fishing charter marina with the largest fleet on Alabama's Gulf Coast, offering inshore and offshore fishing, cruises, dining, and dry storage.
about.vibe: Family-friendly, adventurous, nautical, welcoming to all experience levels
about.reservations: Available for restaurant and private charters
about.insider_tip: Zeke's restaurant offers 'hook and cook' service - catch your fish and have the restaurant prepare it. Best place to watch sunsets on the Alabama Gulf Coast.

reviews.author: April C.
reviews.quote: Captain Colby was amazing! He shared his knowledge of the area, fishing hot spots, and was very patient with our kids. Our family had a great fishing experience, great catches for the day, and made lots of great memories! Highly recommend them, we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Kim R.
reviews.quote: Such an amazing adventure! The captain and mate made sure our trip was a memorable experience. We caught our snapper limit, along with some bonus fish. My son reeled in an amberjack and fought a huge snapper that he lost to a shark! We had zero complaints about this trip and crew. We'll be back!

reviews.author: Bart B.
reviews.quote: Zeke's Landing is the best marina on the Alabama Gulf Coast! I've been fishing out of this marina since the 1980's. Lots of great memories made here. Zeke's restaurant also offers 'hook and cook'. It's truly a 5-star experience every time. The best place to watch sunsets, too!

reviews.author: Dan W.
reviews.quote: My son and I had a wonderful experience. Captain Ricky was great and definitely put us on the fish, and deckhands Jamie and Rhett were terrific. We did an 8-hour trip and loved it. Would highly recommend it and hope to do it again one day!
